requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text:
当按下连接在 D2 引脚的按钮（上拉输入）时，点亮 D13 LED，松开时熄灭。
验收约定：使用INPUT_PULLUP，低电平表示按下；输出响应时间不超过20ms。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: io_0 transitions from true (released, HIGH) to false (pressed, LOW) then back to true (released).
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_1 follows the pressed condition: it is false when released and true when pressed, with LED state matching within the first control step (<=20ms).
